name: Menu hierarchy - - Platform guide - Toast Tab
snippet: Menus are the highest level of the hierarchy and represent top-level categories for the offerings your restaurant serves, for example, Food, Drinks, Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, or Bar.

name: Menu Build Guide - Revel Systems
snippet: This guide is designed to help users build their products, organize their menus, and understand the various aspects of the products page as it affects the POS. Note: the Management Console must be configured before you can use the iPad POS.

name: How to Use Menu Hierarchy with Toast POS: Build Better
snippet: Learn how to use Toast POS’s menu hierarchy to organize your restaurant menus efficiently. Discover best practices for building menus, using modifiers, and optimizing the order process across in-house and online platforms.

name: Create and update menus | Square Support Center - United States
snippet: After you create your menu, you can manage your restaurant POS modes, online ordering, kiosks, and delivery apps across all locations from a single place in your Square Dashboard.

name: Menu Management: How to Use Menu Management - TouchBistro
snippet: Menu Management is used to create and update your TouchBistro POS's menu using TouchBistro Cloud. Using the Menu Management feature, you can add new menu items, change prices, edit/create new discounts, and do much more.

name: Menu Management | Quantic POS Learning Resources
snippet: Here, you can create the menu, create super-categories, categories, and add the items in their respective sections. This process ensures seamless ordering and reporting.

name: Menu Management
snippet: Menu Management: Modifier Groups This guide will show you how to add ways to modify menu items via menu item modifiers and kitchen instructions.
